name: smartcompanion
description: Monorepo for the SmartCompanion library packages: data, services and UI components for audio-guide apps.
author: SmartCompanion Team <hello@smartcompanion.app> (https://smartcompanion.app)

scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/data -w packages/services -w packages/ui --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/data -w packages/services -w packages/ui --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/data -w packages/services -w packages/ui --if-present
scripts.format: npm run format -w packages/data -w packages/services -w packages/ui --if-present
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check -w packages/data -w packages/services -w packages/ui --if-present
scripts.check:publish: npm run check:publish -w packages/data -w packages/services -w packages/ui
